text:
olga: Heads-up — we're rolling a RBAC change for private/on‑prem clusters tomorrow at 0900 PT. Primary goals: tighten operator privileges, enforce default deny egress, ensure KMS audit logs are delivered and retained. Ping @samir and @maria-sre for vuln/compat triage. Draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-hardening (WIP)

samir: can you paste the exact Role/ClusterRole diff you're planning? need to scan for any bindings that implicitly rely on cluster-admin.

olga: sure, here's the minimal change i'm going to apply to the operator binding (will open PR):

```
# remove cluster-admin binding for redwood-operator
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: redwood-operator
rules:
- apiGroups: ["apps", ""]
  resources: ["deployments", "pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","update","patch"]
# removed: verbs: ["*"] from cluster-admin
```

maria-sre: removing cluster-admin is fine from a principle-of-least-privilege view, but note the operator currently calls the node-provisioning endpoint. if you scope the role we need a separate role for that flow or an explicit serviceaccount in the infra namespace. also +1 on egress deny but we need a clear allowlist: prometheus, logs collector, KMS endpoints.

sec-bot: [vuln-alert] CVE-2026-1946 matched in image redwood-runtime:2.9.1 — potential privilege escalation if kubeapi is exposed to runtime. Severity: Moderate. See https://vulns.redwood/cves/CVE-2026-1946

paul-priv: noted. Draft NetworkPolicy idea: default deny ingress/egress in runtime namespaces, allow ingress from control-plane CIDR, allow egress to:
- kms.redwood.com:443
- metrics.redwood.net:9090
- logs.redwood.net:443
I'll post a kubectl manifest in the repo. gist: https://gist.github.com/paul/netpol-draft

katie-compliance: FYI: current private deployment audit retention defaults to 90 days. customer is asking for 365 days and HSM-import capability for KMS. Legal needs to sign off on retention extension and key import terms. If we enable import, we have to update the customer onboarding checklist and the KMS policy template.

samir: for audit logs: apiserver -> audit webhook over mTLS to our collector is the plan. example flags we add to kube-apiserver config: 

```
--audit-policy-file=/etc/kubernetes/audit-policy.yaml
--audit-webhook-config-file=/etc/kubernetes/webhook-config.yaml
--audit-log-path=/var/log/kube-audit/audit.log
```

Make sure webhook config uses client cert and enforces TLS endpoint pinning to the collector. Also CICD must box the webhook certs into the cluster bootstrap.

olga: action items from this thread: 
1) maria-sre -> propose scoped operator roles (replace cluster-admin usage) by EOD today.
2) paul-priv -> land NetworkPolicy draft + smoke test in staging before 0900 PT tomorrow.
3) samir -> update apiserver audit webhook config in our bootstrap repo + add e2e for mTLS.
4) katie-compliance -> confirm retention extension + legal signoff for 365 days and HSM import path.
5) olga -> update runbook + incident playbook for CVE-2026-1946.
If vuln escalates, @oncall please page per incident runbook.

maria-sre: i'll open the RBAC PR now. note: existing clusters will need a small migration script to rebind the node-provision SA to the new scoped role; i'll include a kustomize overlay.

paul-priv: scheduling a smoke test for 0800 PT tomorrow against staging-onprem-3, will A/B with canary customer. i'll include curl checks to kms.redwood.com and prometheus scrape. :thumbsup:

oncall: Oncall rota — samir is aware and will be primary for triage. PagerDuty escalation intact.

olga: great — thanks everyone. i'll move follow-ups into #eng-security-runs and tag the PRs. if you find anything blocking in the next 2 hours call it out here and i'll delay the rollout.

maria-sre: quick note — adding unit tests for the role binding, and a smoke script that asserts no extra privileges (kubectl auth can-i). I'll post results to the PR.

sec-bot: [info] Scheduled scan for redwood-runtime images in staging at 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

olga: closing thread for now — will reopen if any blockers. thanks!
